header.heading: Find Your Problem Here
header.subtext: We built Appriyo's products by listening to business owners talk about what frustrated them every day.

repairShop.problem: Managing repair jobs on paper or WhatsApp — and losing track of customer orders
repairShop.solution: Amar Repair gives your shop a digital system for tracking every job, customer, and payment — from intake to delivery.

coachingCenter.problem: Tracking students, fees, and batches in notebooks — spending hours on manual follow-ups
coachingCenter.solution: Amar Batch handles attendance, fees, and batch scheduling so you focus on teaching, not administration.

businessCards.problem: Handing out paper business cards that get lost — and missing connections because of it
businessCards.solution: Amar Card is a single NFC tap that shares your full contact profile. One card. No reprinting.

manualTasks.problem: Staff spending hours daily on tasks that a system could handle automatically
manualTasks.solution: We map your workflow, identify what can be automated, and build the system — so your team spends time where it matters.

noSystem.problem: Running entirely on WhatsApp, Excel, or memory — no digital system at all
noSystem.solution: We start with a consultation, map your workflow, and recommend what to build first. A clear plan. A partner to execute it.

cta.heading: Don't See Your Problem Here?
cta.subtext: Tell us what's slowing you down in your own words.
